Inside Scoop Tim Cook Is Hoarding His Apple Stock Company executives and directors have sold only a fourth of the shares they did in the year-ago period. By Ed Lin July 18, 2018 11:28 a.m. ET
Apple shares may not be able to repeat last year’s 48% surge, with shares up only a miserly 14% so far this year, excluding dividend payments. The relative underperformance comes despite raised dividends, record stock buybacks, and the power of Oprah.
Slower Apple (ticker: AAPL) iPhone sales and the company’s status in the ever-hotter U.S.-China trade war has many investors practicing moderation.
